error.name: BUFFERTOOSMALL
error.description: a provided buffer is too small

error.name: COULDNOTLOADLIBRARY
error.description: the library could not be loaded

error.name: COULDNOTFINDLIBRARYEXPORT
error.description: a required exported symbol could not be found in the library

error.name: INCOMPATIBLEBINARYVERSION
error.description: the version of the binary interface does not match the bindings interface

error.name: OUTOFVIEWPORT
error.description: target is outside of the viewport

error.name: RECORDINGTOOLARGE
error.description: recording would exceed the maximum sample count

error.name: LASERINDEXHASNOASSIGNEDSCANNER
error.description: toolpath contains segments without laser index

error.name: DUPLICATELASERINDEX
error.description: laser index is assigned to more than one scanner

error.name: NOEXECUTIONAVAILABLE
error.description: scanner has not executed a list yet

error.name: CANNOTREMOVECONFIGUREDSCANNER
error.description: scanners of the driver configuration can not be removed

error.name: IMAGESIZEMISMATCH
error.description: image size does not match the scanner image

method.name: Configure
method.description: Configures a driver with its specific configuration data.

method.name: GetName
method.description: returns the name identifier of the driver

method.name: GetType
method.description: returns the type identifier of the driver

method.name: GetVersion
method.description: returns the version identifiers of the driver

method.name: QueryParameters
method.description: Updates the driver parameters in the driver environment. Should only be called in the driver thread.

method.name: QueryParametersEx
method.description: Updates the driver parameters in the driver environment. Might be called out of thread. Implementation MUST be able to handle parallel calls.

class.name: ExecutionStatistics
class.description: Statistics of a list execution. The values are a snapshot taken when the instance was created.

method.name: GetResult
method.description: Returns how the execution ended.

param.name: Fault
param.description: Fault that ended the execution. None if no fault occurred.

param.name: CommandIndex
param.description: Command index at which the execution ended.

param.name: TimeInMicroseconds
param.description: Emulated time at which the execution ended.

method.name: GetEmulatedDurationInMicroseconds
method.description: Returns the emulated duration of the complete list, independent of how the execution ended.

method.name: GetRealtimeDurationInMicroseconds
method.description: Returns the real-time duration of the complete list, taking into account time scale and slowdown faults.

method.name: GetMarkLengthInMM
method.description: Returns the total mark length.

method.name: GetMarkTimeInMicroseconds
method.description: Returns the time spent moving in mark movements.

method.name: GetJumpLengthInMM
method.description: Returns the total jump length.

method.name: GetJumpTimeInMicroseconds
method.description: Returns the time spent moving in jump movements.

method.name: GetScannerDelayTimeInMicroseconds
method.description: Returns the time spent in jump, mark and polygon delays.

method.name: GetCustomDelayTimeInMicroseconds
method.description: Returns the time spent in custom delays.

method.name: GetSkywritingTimeInMicroseconds
method.description: Returns the time spent in skywriting run-up and run-out phases.

method.name: GetLaserOnTimeInMicroseconds
method.description: Returns the time the laser signal is on.

method.name: GetCommandCount
method.description: Returns the number of commands in the list.

method.name: GetMarkSequenceCount
method.description: Returns the number of mark sequences in the list.

method.name: GetOutOfViewportCount
method.description: Returns the number of targets that were outside of the viewport.

param.name: Count
param.description: Number of targets outside of the viewport.

method.name: GetLaserOffDelayWarningCount
method.description: Returns the number of mark sequences in which the laser off delay is larger than the mark delay.

class.name: Scanner
class.description: An emulated scanner with its laser.

method.name: GetName
method.description: Returns the name of the scanner.

method.name: GetViewport
method.description: Returns the viewport of the scanner in scanner units.

method.name: GetUnitsInMM
method.description: Returns the size of one scanner unit in mm.

param.name: UnitsInMM
param.description: Size of one scanner unit in mm.

method.name: SetLaserIndex
method.description: Sets the laser index of the scanner. Fails while the scanner is busy.

param.name: LaserIndex
param.description: Laser index. 0 means the scanner draws all segments.

method.name: GetLaserIndex
method.description: Returns the laser index of the scanner.

param.name: LaserIndex
param.description: Laser index. 0 means the scanner draws all segments.

method.name: SetMaxLaserPower
method.description: Sets the laser power that corresponds to 100 percent. Toolpath powers in Watts are converted with it.

param.name: MaxPowerInWatts
param.description: Maximum laser power in Watts. MUST be positive.

method.name: GetMaxLaserPower
method.description: Returns the laser power that corresponds to 100 percent.

method.name: SetFastMode
method.description: Sets the fast mode. Fails while the scanner is busy.

param.name: FastMode
param.description: If true, executions finish immediately. If false, they run in real time.

method.name: IsFastMode
method.description: Returns the fast mode.

param.name: FastMode
param.description: If true, executions finish immediately. If false, they run in real time.

method.name: SetTimeScale
method.description: Sets the time scale of real-time executions. Fails while the scanner is busy.

param.name: TimeScale
param.description: Emulated time per real time. 1.0 is real time, 10.0 runs ten times faster. MUST be positive.

method.name: GetTimeScale
method.description: Returns the time scale of real-time executions.

method.name: SetOutOfViewportPolicy
method.description: Sets how targets outside of the viewport are handled.

method.name: GetOutOfViewportPolicy
method.description: Returns how targets outside of the viewport are handled.

method.name: SetTransformationMatrix
method.description: Sets the transformation matrix that is applied to all targets before the offset. The default is the identity.

param.name: M11
param.description: Upper left field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: M12
param.description: Upper right field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: M21
param.description: Lower left field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: M22
param.description: Lower right field of the transformation matrix.

method.name: SetTransformationOffset
method.description: Sets the offset that is added to all targets after the transformation matrix. The default is 0/0.

param.name: OffsetX
param.description: Offset in X in scanner units.

param.name: OffsetY
param.description: Offset in Y in scanner units.

method.name: GetTransformation
method.description: Returns the transformation that is applied to all targets.

param.name: M11
param.description: Upper left field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: M12
param.description: Upper right field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: M21
param.description: Lower left field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: M22
param.description: Lower right field of the transformation matrix.

param.name: OffsetX
param.description: Offset in X in scanner units.

param.name: OffsetY
param.description: Offset in Y in scanner units.

method.name: ResetTransformation
method.description: Resets the transformation to the identity.

method.name: SetJumpSpeed
method.description: Sets the default jump speed at the start of every execution.

param.name: JumpSpeed
param.description: Jump speed in mm/s. MUST be positive.

method.name: GetJumpSpeed
method.description: Returns the default jump speed.

method.name: SetMarkSpeed
method.description: Sets the default mark speed at the start of every execution.

param.name: MarkSpeed
param.description: Mark speed in mm/s. MUST be positive.

method.name: GetMarkSpeed
method.description: Returns the default mark speed.

method.name: SetPower
method.description: Sets the default laser power at the start of every execution.

method.name: GetPower
method.description: Returns the default laser power.

method.name: SetDelays
method.description: Sets the default delays at the start of every execution.

param.name: LaserOnDelay
param.description: Laser on delay in microseconds. May be negative.

param.name: LaserOffDelay
param.description: Laser off delay in microseconds. May be negative.

param.name: JumpDelay
param.description: Jump delay in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

param.name: MarkDelay
param.description: Mark delay in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

param.name: PolygonDelay
param.description: Polygon delay in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

method.name: GetDelays
method.description: Returns the default delays.

method.name: SetSkywriting
method.description: Sets the default skywriting at the start of every execution.

param.name: Timelag
param.description: Timelag in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

param.name: NPrev
param.description: Run-up duration in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

param.name: NPost
param.description: Run-out duration in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

param.name: Limit
param.description: Cosine of the angle limit for mode 3 and 4. MUST be between -1 and 1.

method.name: GetSkywriting
method.description: Returns the default skywriting.

method.name: ClearList
method.description: Discards the open list. Fails while the scanner is busy.

method.name: GetListCommandCount
method.description: Returns the number of commands in the open list.

method.name: AddJumpMovement
method.description: Adds a jump movement to the open list.

method.name: AddMarkMovement
method.description: Adds a mark movement to the open list.

method.name: AddSetJumpSpeed
method.description: Adds a jump speed change to the open list.

param.name: JumpSpeed
param.description: Jump speed in mm/s. MUST be positive.

method.name: AddSetMarkSpeed
method.description: Adds a mark speed change to the open list.

param.name: MarkSpeed
param.description: Mark speed in mm/s. MUST be positive.

method.name: AddSetPower
method.description: Adds a power change to the open list.

method.name: AddSetDelays
method.description: Adds a delay change to the open list.

param.name: LaserOnDelay
param.description: Laser on delay in microseconds. May be negative.

param.name: LaserOffDelay
param.description: Laser off delay in microseconds. May be negative.

param.name: JumpDelay
param.description: Jump delay in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

param.name: MarkDelay
param.description: Mark delay in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

param.name: PolygonDelay
param.description: Polygon delay in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

method.name: AddCustomDelay
method.description: Adds a custom delay to the open list. The laser is off during the delay.

param.name: Delay
param.description: Delay in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

method.name: AddEnableSkywriting
method.description: Adds enabling skywriting to the open list. Takes effect at the next mark sequence.

param.name: Mode
param.description: Skywriting mode. MUST NOT be Off.

param.name: Timelag
param.description: Timelag in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

param.name: NPrev
param.description: Run-up duration in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

param.name: NPost
param.description: Run-out duration in microseconds. MUST NOT be negative.

param.name: Limit
param.description: Cosine of the angle limit for mode 3 and 4. MUST be between -1 and 1.

method.name: AddDisableSkywriting
method.description: Adds disabling skywriting to the open list. Takes effect at the next mark sequence.

method.name: AddLayerToList
method.description: Adds all segments of a toolpath layer to the open list. If the scanner has a laser index, only segments with that laser index are added.

param.name: FailIfNonAssignedDataExists
param.description: If true, fails if the layer contains segments without laser index.

method.name: ExecuteList
method.description: Computes the timeline of the open list and starts its execution. The open list is empty afterwards. Fails while the scanner is busy, if a latched fault is active, or if a start fault fires.

method.name: WaitForList
method.description: Waits until the current execution has ended. Throws the error of a fault that ended the execution, once.

param.name: TimeOutInMilliseconds
param.description: Maximum time to wait in real time.

param.name: Finished
param.description: Returns false if the timeout expired before the execution ended.

method.name: StopExecution
method.description: Stops the current execution at the current emulated time. Does nothing if the scanner is not busy.

method.name: IsBusy
method.description: Returns if an execution is running.

param.name: Busy
param.description: True while an execution is running.

method.name: DrawLayer
method.description: Clears the open list, adds a layer of a build stream, executes it and waits until it has ended.

param.name: StreamUUID
param.description: UUID of the build stream. Must have been loaded in memory by the system.

param.name: LayerIndex
param.description: Layer index of the build file.

method.name: GetStatus
method.description: Returns the current status of the scanner. Never throws a fault.

param.name: CommandIndex
param.description: Command index of the current or last execution.

param.name: Progress
param.description: Progress of the current or last execution, from 0 to 1.

method.name: GetPosition
method.description: Returns the current position of the scan head.

method.name: IsLaserOn
method.description: Returns if the laser signal is on.

param.name: LaserOn
param.description: True if the laser signal is on.

method.name: GetHeadStatus
method.description: Returns the status flags of the scan head.

param.name: PositionOK
param.description: False while a position error is active.

param.name: TemperatureOK
param.description: False while a temperature error is active.

param.name: PowerOK
param.description: False while a power error is active.

method.name: GetLastExecutionStatistics
method.description: Returns the statistics of the current or last execution. Fails if there was no execution yet.

method.name: EnableRecording
method.description: Enables the recording of the following executions.

param.name: SampleIntervalInMicroseconds
param.description: Sample interval. 0 records one row per command boundary and laser switch.

method.name: DisableRecording
method.description: Disables the recording of the following executions.

method.name: HasRecording
method.description: Returns if the last execution was recorded.

param.name: RecordingExists
param.description: True if a recording is available.

method.name: WriteRecordingToDataTable
method.description: Writes the recording of the last execution into a data table. Adds the columns time_us, x, y, laser_on, power and command_index. Existing columns of the same name are replaced.

param.name: DataTable
param.description: Data table instance to write to.

method.name: SetFaultSeed
method.description: Sets the seed of the fault random generator.

method.name: InjectFault
method.description: Injects a fault immediately. A running execution ends at the current emulated time. Busy and LaserNotReady affect the next execution.

param.name: FaultType
param.description: Fault type. MUST NOT be None.

method.name: ScheduleFaultAtCommand
method.description: Schedules a fault for the next execution at a command index. The trigger is discarded if the execution ends before.

param.name: FaultType
param.description: Fault type. MUST NOT be None.

param.name: CommandIndex
param.description: Command index at which the fault fires.

method.name: ScheduleFaultAtTime
method.description: Schedules a fault for the next execution at an emulated time. The trigger is discarded if the execution ends before.

param.name: FaultType
param.description: Fault type. MUST NOT be None.

param.name: TimeInMicroseconds
param.description: Emulated time at which the fault fires. MUST NOT be negative.

method.name: ScheduleFaultAtExecution
method.description: Schedules a fault for the n-th execution from now, at a random point of it.

param.name: FaultType
param.description: Fault type. MUST NOT be None.

param.name: ExecutionCount
param.description: 1 is the next execution. MUST be positive.

method.name: SetRandomFault
method.description: Lets a fault fire in each execution with a probability, at a random point of it. A probability of 0 removes the random fault.

param.name: FaultType
param.description: Fault type. MUST NOT be None.

method.name: SetSlowdownFactor
method.description: Sets the factor by which a Slowdown fault stretches the real-time duration of an execution.

param.name: Factor
param.description: Slowdown factor. MUST be at least 1.

method.name: GetSlowdownFactor
method.description: Returns the factor by which a Slowdown fault stretches the real-time duration of an execution.

method.name: ClearFaultInjection
method.description: Removes all scheduled and random fault triggers. Does not reset an active fault.

method.name: GetActiveFault
method.description: Returns the active fault.

param.name: FaultType
param.description: Active fault. None if no fault is active.

method.name: ResetFault
method.description: Resets an active fault. Fails while the scanner is busy.

method.name: GetFaultCount
method.description: Returns the number of faults that fired since the scanner was created.

class.name: ScannerImage
class.description: A debug image of a build plate window. Every finished execution of an assigned scanner is drawn into it as microsteps. Colors are 0xRRGGBB values.

method.name: GetName
method.description: Returns the name of the scanner image.

method.name: GetWindow
method.description: Returns the build plate window of the image in mm.

method.name: GetPixelCount
method.description: Returns the size of the image in pixels.

method.name: SetBackgroundColor
method.description: Sets the color of pixels that have not been drawn.

method.name: GetBackgroundColor
method.description: Returns the color of pixels that have not been drawn.

method.name: SetMicrostepInterval
method.description: Sets the time between two drawn positions of the scan head. Default is 10 microseconds.

param.name: IntervalInMicroseconds
param.description: Microstep interval in microseconds. MUST be between 0.1 and 1000000.

method.name: GetMicrostepInterval
method.description: Returns the time between two drawn positions of the scan head.

method.name: AssignScanner
method.description: Draws the executions of a scanner into this image. Assigning a scanner again replaces its settings.

param.name: SpotRadiusInMM
param.description: Radius of the drawn spot in mm. 0 draws single pixels.

param.name: LaserOnColor
param.description: Color of microsteps with the laser on, as 0xRRGGBB.

param.name: LaserOffColor
param.description: Color of microsteps with the laser off, as 0xRRGGBB.

param.name: DrawLaserOff
param.description: If false, only microsteps with the laser on are drawn.

method.name: UnassignScanner
method.description: Stops drawing the executions of a scanner. Does nothing if the scanner is not assigned.

method.name: IsScannerAssigned
method.description: Returns if a scanner is assigned to this image.

param.name: IsAssigned
param.description: True if the scanner is assigned.

method.name: SetRecording
method.description: Pauses or resumes drawing into the image. Recording is on after creation.

param.name: Recording
param.description: If false, finished executions are not drawn.

method.name: IsRecording
method.description: Returns if finished executions are drawn into the image.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Resets all pixels to the background.

method.name: GetPixelColor
method.description: Returns the color of a pixel. Pixel (0, 0) is the top left corner, at (X1, Y2) of the window.

method.name: GetPixelHitCount
method.description: Returns how many executions have drawn into a pixel.

method.name: WriteToImageData
method.description: Writes the image into an image data instance of the same pixel size.

param.name: ImageData
param.description: Image instance. MUST have the pixel size of the scanner image.

class.name: Driver_ScannerEmulator
class.description: A driver that emulates laser scanners.

method.name: CreateScanner
method.description: Creates a new scanner.

param.name: Name
param.description: Name of the scanner. Alphanumeric and underscore. MUST be unique.

param.name: X1
param.description: Minimum X of the viewport in scanner units.

param.name: Y1
param.description: Minimum Y of the viewport in scanner units.

param.name: X2
param.description: Maximum X of the viewport in scanner units. MUST be larger than X1.

param.name: Y2
param.description: Maximum Y of the viewport in scanner units. MUST be larger than Y1.

param.name: UnitsInMM
param.description: Size of one scanner unit in mm. MUST be positive.

method.name: HasScanner
method.description: Returns if a scanner exists.

method.name: FindScanner
method.description: Returns a scanner by name. Fails if the scanner does not exist.

method.name: RemoveScanner
method.description: Removes a scanner. Fails while the scanner is busy. Scanners from the configuration can not be removed.

method.name: GetScannerCount
method.description: Returns the number of scanners.

method.name: GetScanner
method.description: Returns a scanner by index. Scanners are ordered by name.

method.name: DrawLayerMultiLaser
method.description: Draws a layer on all scanners with a laser index in parallel and waits until all have ended. Fails if two scanners have the same laser index.

param.name: StreamUUID
param.description: UUID of the build stream. Must have been loaded in memory by the system.

param.name: LayerIndex
param.description: Layer index of the build file.

param.name: FailIfNonAssignedDataExists
param.description: If true, fails if the layer contains segments without laser index.

method.name: CreateScannerImage
method.description: Creates a debug image of a build plate window.

param.name: Name
param.description: Name of the image. Alphanumeric and underscore. MUST be unique.

param.name: X1
param.description: Minimum X of the window in mm.

param.name: Y1
param.description: Minimum Y of the window in mm.

param.name: X2
param.description: Maximum X of the window in mm. MUST be larger than X1.

param.name: Y2
param.description: Maximum Y of the window in mm. MUST be larger than Y1.

param.name: PixelCountX
param.description: Number of pixels in X. MUST be between 1 and 16384.

param.name: PixelCountY
param.description: Number of pixels in Y. MUST be between 1 and 16384. The image MUST NOT have more than 4096 x 4096 pixels in total.

method.name: HasScannerImage
method.description: Returns if a scanner image exists.

method.name: FindScannerImage
method.description: Returns a scanner image by name. Fails if the image does not exist.

method.name: RemoveScannerImage
method.description: Removes a scanner image. Drawing into it stops, even if the plugin still holds the instance.

method.name: GetScannerImageCount
method.description: Returns the number of scanner images.

method.name: GetVersion
method.description: retrieves the binary version of this library.

param.name: Major
param.description: returns the major version of this library

param.name: Minor
param.description: returns the minor version of this library

param.name: Micro
param.description: returns the micro version of this library

method.name: GetLastError
method.description: Returns the last error recorded on this object

param.name: HasError
param.description: Is there a last error to query

method.name: ReleaseInstance
method.description: Releases shared ownership of an Instance

method.name: AcquireInstance
method.description: Acquires shared ownership of an Instance

method.name: InjectComponent
method.description: Injects an imported component for usage within this component

param.name: SymbolAddressMethod
param.description: Address of the SymbolAddressMethod of the injected component

method.name: GetSymbolLookupMethod
method.description: Returns the address of the SymbolLookupMethod

method.name: CreateDriver
method.description: Creates a driver instance with a specific name.

param.name: Name
param.description: Name of driver to be created.

param.name: Type
param.description: Type of driver to be created.
